source.name: Z-Anatomy
modifications: Selected muscles, tendons, and supporting skeletal surfaces; internal systems excluded.
Normalized feet to Y=0 and height to 2; anterior faces +Z.
Replaced Blender display shaders with PBR materials, preserving tendon assignments.
Authored 2K multiscale directional fibre normal and roughness maps with per-muscle cylindrical UVs.
Denoised muscle interiors with bounded nonshrinking smoothing; softened regular muscle/tendon boundary curves by at most 0.75 mm while preserving material identities and attachment tips.
Applied one contour-subdivision level to broad low-density pectoral, deltoid, gluteal and trapezius meshes.
Joined, welded, and subdivided source head/hand/foot surface regions.
Corrected swapped ascending/descending trapezius labels by actual source placement.
Meshopt-compressed with 16-bit positions, 14-bit normals and high-precision UVs; no geometry decimation.
